summary.text: Renee LaMark Muir represents the 36th House District, which serves Chester, Deep River, Essex and Haddam.

paragraphs.text: She grew up in Ivoryton and earned bachelor's and master's degrees in criminal justice and law enforcement administration from John Jay College of Criminal Justice in New York City.
She worked as a special investigator for the New York City Department of Investigation and founded Justice Solutions Consulting in 2016.
LaMark Muir serves on Deep River's Economic Development Commission and Zoning Board of Appeals and has lived in Deep River for almost 30 years.
